## Theorem box

Use `.theorem` for formal statements. Add a name via the `data-name` attribute.

::: {.theorem data-name="Frisch-Waugh-Lovell"}
Let $y$, $D$, and $X$ be as defined above. Then the coefficient on $D$
from a regression of $y$ on $D$ and $X$ equals the coefficient from a
regression of the residuals of $y$ on the residuals of $D$, both
regressed on $X$.
:::
